mechanism_narrative: Accelerating GDP growth, as measured by the year-over-year change in real GDP, signals a strengthening economy that will boost corporate earnings and drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Y-o-y GDPC1 growth accelerates by > 2pp but SPX 60-day forward returns are negative > 40% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: When the ISM manufacturing index (proxied by INDPRO) falls below 50 for two consecutive months, it signals an impending recession that will drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: INDPRO < 50 trigger fires but SPX 20-day forward returns are positive > 60% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp spike in the unemployment rate, defined as an increase of > 0.5pp in one month, signals a rapidly deteriorating labor market that will drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: UNRATE spike trigger fires but SPX 5-day forward returns are positive > 50% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 4.5%, it signals a restrictive monetary policy that will drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days, especially if accompanied by an inverted yield curve.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS > 4.5% trigger fires but SPX 20-day forward returns are positive > 60% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in housing starts, defined as a 10% y-o-y drop in HOUST, signals a weakening consumer sector that will drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: HOUST 10% y-o-y decline trigger fires but SPX 60-day forward returns are positive > 50% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in payroll employment, defined as a decline of > 200k jobs in one month, signals a rapidly deteriorating labor market that will drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: PAYEMS 200k job loss trigger fires but SPX 5-day forward returns are positive > 50% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: A rapid rise in the consumer price index, defined as a 3-month annualized inflation rate exceeding 5%, signals an overheating economy that will drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days, especially if accompanied by rising interest rates.
failure_condition: CPIAUCSL 5% trigger fires but SPX 20-day forward returns are positive > 60% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in real consumer spending, defined as a 1% m-o-m decline in RSAFS, signals a rapidly weakening consumer sector that will drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: RSAFS 1% m-o-m decline trigger fires but SPX 5-day forward returns are positive > 50% of the time.
